scope: current workspace source, isolated temporary data directory
method: launch the source with the workspace Python runtime, poll for the visible top-level window, sample the process about 0.4 seconds after window creation, then close it
limitations: This is time to visible window, not time to every background service becoming ready.
The source worktree is dirty, so the exact tested state is identified by the files in the workspace rather than by the commit alone.
Windows compositor frame pacing and real mouse or touchpad latency were not sampled.
